name: cache
description: Configures caching services by installing Memcached, setting up Redis with authentication, creating log directories, and cleaning up Redis defaults.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application by installing system packages, cloning source, building a Python virtual environment, installing dependencies, creating a PostgreSQL database and user, writing an .env file, and registering a systemd service.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Sets up Nginx with multiple SSL-enabled virtual hosts, applies security hardening including fail2ban, ufw, sysctl, and generates self-signed certificates for each site.
